conventions.convention: Future null completeness concerns the upper endpoint of the maximal affine extension in M. Positive affine reparametrization preserves completeness; incompleteness asserts neither curvature divergence nor a singular point in M.
Use signature (-,+,+,+), future null normals with negative pairing against N, null second fundamental form χℓ(X,Y)=g(∇Xℓ,Y), and expansion θℓ=trq χℓ.

A future trapped surface is nonempty, compact, embedded, spacelike and without boundary; both local future null rays have strictly negative expansion. Local normal pairs suffice, and positive rescaling or interchanging ray labels preserves trapping.

The black region and event horizon are relative to a supplied conformal completion and designated null boundary. They are undefined without that data and are not identified with trapped or marginally outer trapped surfaces.
The Cauchy-slice identification requires a supplied smooth product diffeomorphism whose parameter curves are inextendible future timelike curves, and a smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface.

The compactness lemma assumes Countable Choice and Dependent Choice, normalizes initial null normals by g(ℓ,N)=-1, and permits an endpoint at the first focal instant; only strictly later generator points are excluded.

Penrose incompleteness assumes AC, global hyperbolicity, a connected noncompact smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface, compact future trapping, and the direct geometric inequality Ric(v,v)≥0 for null v. No Einstein equation or matter interpretation is used.
In the de Sitter example, H>0 has units m⁻¹, τ and affine parameters have units m, a(τ)=H⁻¹cosh(Hτ), and the trapped equatorial spheres lie at τ0<0.

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice. In a globally hyperbolic time-oriented smooth Lorentzian four-manifold, let S be a nonempty compact smooth embedded spacelike future trapped two-surface. If Ric(ℓ,ℓ)≥0 for every null vector and every future null geodesic is future complete, then E⁺(S)=∂I⁺(S) is a closed topological three-manifold without boundary and is compact.

Assume AC. A globally hyperbolic smooth time-oriented Lorentzian four-manifold with a connected noncompact smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface, a nonempty compact smooth spacelike future trapped two-surface, and Ric(v,v)≥0 for every null vector is future null geodesically incomplete. This asserts no curvature divergence or singular point belonging to M.

For a supplied smooth diffeomorphism Ψ:ℝ×S0→M with inextendible future timelike parameter curves and Ψ(0,z)=z, projection along those curves restricts to a diffeomorphism from any smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface Σ onto S0. Consequently Σ and S0 have the same connectedness and compactness properties.

Future trapping means that both local future null normal expansions of a nonempty compact embedded spacelike two-manifold without boundary are strictly negative everywhere; their signs are independent of positive normal rescaling and local ray interchange.

The spacetime is future null geodesically complete when every future-directed null geodesic is future complete, meaning its maximal future affine interval is unbounded above; it is future null geodesically incomplete when at least one is not.

concerns.concern: Fact F17 attributes 'the continuous image of a compact topological space is compact' to thm-continuous-image-of-a-compact-space-is-compact. That supplier instead begins 'Let (X,d_X) and (Y,d_Y) be metric spaces.' Step 7.1 applies it to manifold-valued exponential maps without supplying compatible metrics. The compactness conclusion is sound, but the quoted supplier is broader than its actual statement. The already published thm-compactness-under-continuous-maps supplies the required topological version.

alerts.finding: Clause (e) defines H⁺(S)=D⁺(S)\I⁻(D⁺(S)), then describes it as points 'that are not chronologically preceded by any point of D⁺(S)'. The displayed subtraction instead excludes points that chronologically precede some point of D⁺(S): membership in I⁻(D⁺(S)) means ∃q∈D⁺(S), p≪q. The prose reverses the chronological direction.

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplier page and normal-plane, screen, Raychaudhuri, index-form and focal-exclusion interfaces against the batch's uses.
